payload.title: File:Rinconraptor Size Comparison.svg
payload.description_html:
Size of the holotype specimen (MAU-Pv-CO-659) of Rinconraptor pipoae compared to an adult human male (~1.8 m) for reference.

References

  • "Expanding the dinosaur diversity of the Cerro Overo–La Invernada area (Bajo de la Carpa Formation, Santonian), Northern Patagonia: Description of a new species and additional megaraptorid remains"
  • "A new megaraptoran theropod dinosaur from the Upper Cretaceous Bajo de la Carpa Formation of northwestern Patagonia"
  • "Latest Cretaceous megaraptorid theropod dinosaur sheds light on megaraptoran evolution and palaeobiology"
  • "Evidence for avian intrathoracic air sacs in a new predatory dinosaur from Argentina"
  • "Osteology of Aerosteon riocoloradensis (Sereno et al. 2008) a large megaraptoran (Dinosauria: Theropoda) from the Upper Cretaceous of Argentina"
  • "Phylogenetic relationships of the Cretaceous Gondwanan theropods Megaraptor and Australovenator: the evidence afforded by their manual anatomy"
